content.short: Hydro Protocol is the primary liquid staking and LSDFi infrastructure on Injective, optimizing yield efficiency.
content.description: Hydro Protocol is the definitive Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSD) and LSDFi infrastructure built on the Injective Network. By allowing users to stake INJ and receive hINJ (liquid INJ), the protocol enables participants to earn rewards while maintaining liquidity for use across the Injective ecosystem. Beyond basic staking, Hydro features innovative products like Real Yield Assets (RYA), which provide diversified yield sources through indexed baskets. The platform also offers auto-compounding vaults and farming, serving as a core liquidity engine for the Web3 community.
